text:
Seedance 2.0 is now live on @capcutapp!

The biggest difference is how smooth the workflow feels when generation and editing are in the same place. No more exporting or re-uploading assets.

Use it here:
→ Web: Video Studio (omni reference supported)
→ Desktop: Media → AI Video (t2v, i2v supported)
→ App: AI Lab, AI Generator, AI Video (t2v, i2v supported)
content:
Use CapCut Web → Video Studio to access Seedance 2.0 with omni reference support  
Use CapCut Desktop → Media → AI Video to run text-to-video (t2v) and image-to-video (i2v) in Seedance 2.0  
Use CapCut App → AI Lab / AI Generator / AI Video to run text-to-video (t2v) and image-to-video (i2v) in Seedance 2.0
